name: permitio
description: Node.js client library for the Permit.io full-stack permissions platform

scripts.build: pnpm run build:js && pnpm run build:types
scripts.fix: pnpm run fix:prettier && pnpm run fix:lint
scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run --project unit --project module-imports
scripts.test:module-imports: pnpm run build && vitest run --project module-imports
scripts.check-cli: pnpm run test && pnpm run diff-integration-tests && pnpm run check-integration-tests
scripts.diff-integration-tests: mkdir -p diff && rm -rf diff/test && cp -r test diff/test && rm -rf diff/test/test-*/.git && cd diff && git init --quiet && git add -A && git commit --quiet --no-verify --allow-empty -m 'WIP' && echo '\n\nCommitted most recent integration test output in the "diff" directory. Review the changes with "cd diff && git diff HEAD" or your preferred git diff viewer.'
scripts.reset-hard: git clean -dfx && git reset --hard && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.prepare-release: pnpm run reset-hard && pnpm run test && pnpm run doc:html && pnpm run version && pnpm run doc:publish
scripts.generate-openapi-client: openapi-generator-cli generate -i https://api.permit.io/v2/openapi.json -g typescript-axios -o src/openapi/ --additional-properties=useSingleRequestParameter=true,withSeparateModelsAndApi=true,apiPackage=api,modelPackage=types --skip-validate-spec && pnpm fix:prettier
